book.name: 2 Corinthians
book.title: 2 Corinthians Paul Ana Fef Bairou’abin Corinth Isah

content: Orot Babin Hai Ririm Naatu God Ana Fair
Isanimih God ana kabeberamaim iti bowabow bowamih itit, imih men gubamit ehuhuriramih.

Baise yawas biya’ohow hai sinaf kakafih wa’iwa’irih etei hima’am i tabihamiyen, men tabifufuwen o God ana tur tabobotabir kakafemih. Turobe tabibinan, God it ata sifroubonayan, saise afa so’obayah boro hinitutumit.
It tur gewasin tabibinan sabuw isah men nabirerereb na’at iyab kasikasiyih tema’am i boro kasiyomaim hinama.
Anayabin iti tafaram ana god baitumatum atih matah bofafaren, imih tur gewasin ana marakaw ekukusisiar men ti’i’itin naatu Keriso ana fair men tesoso’ob, nati tur i God taiyuwin.
Anayabin aki men taiyuwi isai abibinanamih, baise aki tur a binan a’o’orerereb, Jesu Keriso i Regah naatu Keriso wabinamaim abi’akir kwa isa.
God eo, “Guguminamaim marakaw kukusisiar.” Nati God ta’imon dogorot wanawanan iwa’an marakaw God ana bonamanamarinamaim Keriso yumatanamaim kusisiar ta’itin tasoso’ob.
Baise it iyab ayubit ana sawar gewasih noukwat kamaramaim hibu’ir wanawanan hiya ti’inu’in, ine ebi’obaiyit tasoso’ob fair gagamin i God nowan men it nowatamih.
It mar etei roun roun yabat erarabit, baise men ebimkweyakweyarit, veya ta i takakasiy, baise ata not men erara’iy.
Aki ai rakit moumurin maiyow, baise aki men abigaganamih, veya ta ta i kakafin anababatun wanawanan arur, baise aki men ebi’a’afiyi’imih.
Mar etei aki morob wanamaim abatabat Jesu hirab momorob na’atube, saise i ana yawas aki biyai’imaim nirerereb hina’itin.
Anayabin it iyab yawasit tama’am Jesu wabinamaim it mar etei morobomaim tama’am, saise i ana yawas it biyatamaim nirerereb.
Isan imih, iti ebi’obaiyit morob aki bairi ama areremor baise yawas i kwa bairi kwama’am.
God ana tur Buk Atamaninamaim hikirum hio, “Ayu ao anayabin ayu abitumatum.” Nati ayubin ana baitumatum ta’imon aki auman a’o anayabin abitumatum.
Anayabin aki aso’ob God Regah Jesu morobone biyawas, kwa bairit tanita’imon God nanamaim tanabat.

Sawar tutufin hinamamatar i kwa a gewasin isan. Imih God ana kabeber sabuw moumurih tafahimaim nasuwa, sabuw boro tafan nayababar hinamour hinamisir merarayow God hinitin naatu God ana fair hinabora’ara’ah.
Baitumatumamaim Tanama
Ana’an nati Isan it men gubamit nahurir, basit it biyat eriririm baise wanawanat mar etei ebiboubun.
Anayabin it biyababan naatu bai’akir i men gagamin naatu boro men manin, baise iti biyababan naatu bai’akir imaim boro God ana toto ana buyoy ma’ama wanatowan kwanatarakwib kwanab.

Anayabin it i sawar ta’i’itah isah matat takubar tama ta’i’itinkikin, baise sawar wa’iwa’irih isah men tama tanuwanuwamih. Sawar abistan ta’i’itah i boro men manin hinama, baise sawar abistan wa’iwa’irih i boro hinama wanatowan.
